_comment: C0-15 lm-studio bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（ollama/jan），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk, langgraph]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Download the latest local LLMs directly in-app (as seen on the official site, direct-fetched); GGUF-first, with MLX and llama.cpp dual runtimes (official wording: "Powered by the LM Studio runtime, with MLX and llama.cpp under the hood").
axes.runtime: Desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux); the site now leads with the "Bionic" agent (a local agent for work and code) — the product narrative has expanded from pure chat to agent, per the filing snapshot.
axes.local_files: Models and conversations land on your machine; the site states plainly that speech transcription is "processed locally and never leaves your device" (direct-fetched).
axes.background: A built-in local server (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) can stay on for external clients; default switch and authentication details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The Bionic agent line includes document editing/automation/computer control (official site, direct-fetched); MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: Context management for chat and agent sessions is in-app; cross-session memory and long-term memory — no official statement seen.
axes.permissions: Desktop-app permissions follow the system; the permission boundary of the agent's computer-control surface not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: running local models through a graphical interface, trying the agent (Bionic) in the same app. Does not fit: headless server deployment (use llama.cpp/vLLM); reading the full license terms (the terms page loads dynamically and this site could not direct-fetch it).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full terms page (loads dynamically, direct fetch came back empty — content not guessed)
- The computer-control permission model of the Bionic agent (not verified item by item)
- Cross-session memory capability (no official statement seen)
related: Both out-of-the-box model runners: Ollama's main axis is the command line, LM Studio's GUI and agent narrative are heavier.
Both desktop GUI routes beyond open source: Jan is open-source (Apache2.0 core + attribution), LM Studio is closed-source.
